Name: For Love and Beer - A Pam Romance Mod
Author: pamluvr69
Description:
Ever wanted to romance Pam? Of course you have! Unfortunately, ConcernedApe released an incomplete game, but that's all about to change.

Introducing [b]For Love and Beer, [/b]a romance mod like none you've ever seen. Pam has been completely rewritten to make her ruder, cruder, and more selfish. She's a bully who needs taming, but are you up to the challenge? 

FEATURING:

* A complete rewrite of Pam's character to make her the worst person she can possibly be
* Mostly lore-accurate writing 
* Romance-specific dialogue and options
* [b]Completely voiced[/b] with [b]NO AI[/b](that's right!)

If you'd like to hear Pam's sensuous voice,  download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43961]For Love and Beer: A Pam Romance Mod: Voiceover Add-On Pack[/url], thanks to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33061]Voice Over Framework Mod[/url]. This is how the mod is meant to be played!

[b]THIS MOD IS IN SEMI-ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT AND IS INCOMPLETE.

[/b]There are many missing conditionals in the game, and dialogue is only complete for Spring, Summer, and Fall. I'll finish the rest of the mod if and when I feel like it. There are no cutscenes yet.

[b]IS THIS MOD COMPATIBLE WITH X MOD?
[/b]I don't know. I didn't mess with much, so it should be mostly fine. Cutscenes haven't really been written yet.

[b]THANKS TO
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33061]Voice Over Framework Mod[/url], without which this would never have gotten done.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7000]Romanceable Rasmodious[/url] for referencing.
The Lord. This is all your fault, Lord.

If you use Donation Points on this mod, 100% of proceeds will go to St. Jude's Childrens' Research Hospital.
